exposure: ultrasound stage of PAS (stage 1-3 vs PAS0)
outcome: incidence of small for gestational age (SGA)
incidence of large for gestational age (LGA)
cohort: A total of 53 women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) between January 2018 and December 2021.
finding: A diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) was not associated with fetal growth restriction, nor were there differences in fetal growth or birth weight centiles by ultrasound stage of PAS.
birth_weight: Birth weight centiles were measured, and categories for small for gestational age (birth weight ≤ 10th percentile) and large for gestational age (birth weight ≥ 90th percentile) were assessed.
gest_age: Fetal growth centiles were assessed at median gestational ages of 21, 28, and 33 weeks, and gestational age was used to define small for gestational age and large for gestational age.
